text:
noah: FYI — HelioCare signed up for a 3-week pilot. Requirements: browser + edge aggregator clients, streaming responses, in-band function calls to an internal patient-service, and strictly typed JSON output for discharge notes. They need a quick runbook, security Qs answered, and a price ballpark for ~7k concurrent websocket streams.

meera: Nice. Do they plan to use our official SDKs?

noah: Yes: Rust on the aggregator, JS in-browser. Auth will be via their on-prem proxy issuing ephemeral tokens.

finn: For 7k streams I'd recommend Dedicated reserved capacity with autoscale headroom. Ballpark commit: $15k–$22k/month depending on token mix and inferred avg tokens per session. I'll draft a small pricing table.

jules: On the tooling side, we should insist on a strict JSON Schema for the function call payload/response. Also add server-side output validation before any downstream write.

meera: Agreed. Security will want to see the schema and the validation flow. Also confirm redaction/tokenization options — they don't want PHI leaving their VPC unredacted.

noah: They asked for in-band func-calls (model emits a call like {"tool":"lookup_patient","args":{...}}). Proxy will mediate and may redact fields.

finn: Perf note: in-band synchronous tool calls incur RTT. Recommend colocating proxy and inference region or Private deployment. Add expected RTTs to the runbook (e.g., 80–180ms depending on region).

jules: Minimal EMR lookup schema I pushed to the drive: https://drive.redwood.example/heliocare-schema — include it in the packet. Example (short): patient_id string, scope enum [summary, meds, allergies], reveal boolean. Keep maxLength limits.

meera: For auth: use short-lived JWT from proxy. Add handshake snippet in runbook: `fetch('/auth/shortlived').then(r=>r.json()).then(t=>ws.connect({token:t.value}))`. Also mention resume token for reconnects.

sec-bot: [automated] Checklist: "HelioCare pilot — security packet requested" created by noah at 1759999999

finn: Security questionnaire answers: we provide Dedicated/Private options, KMS integration, audit logs, IP allowlist, and SOC2 report. BAAs available on Private; hosted requires legal. I'll add standard wording.

jules: Add a validation step: server validates model output JSON against schema; if invalid, send a reformat prompt with up to 2 retries, then fallback to a human review queue. Also enforce rate-limits on tool calls and cache recent lookups.

noah: Action items: Finn -> pricing + SOC2/BAA wording; Jules -> schema sample + validation flow; Meera -> SDK snippets + handshake + runbook skeleton. I'll consolidate and send to HelioCare security today.

meera: I'll include a small troubleshooting section (backpressure, reconnection, resume tokens, signal to pause client).

finn: Uploaded pricing draft: https://drive.redwood.example/heliocare-pricing. Please review before I send.

noah: Thanks — if HelioCare insists on raw PHI in prompts, we escalate to Private deployment and legal for BAA. Otherwise use proxy redaction. :thumbsup:

sec-bot: [automated] Reminder set for follow-up in 36h by noah

noah: Sending packet in 2h unless any blockers reported here.
